# D1 · Corporate power and antitrust

**Scope.** Mergers, acquisitions, minority stakes and interlocks; monopolization and exclusionary conduct; merger review outcomes; consent decrees and their enforcement.

## Standing questions

- Which acquisitions or minority investments by watched entities avoided or survived merger review, and on what stated grounds?
- Where has a regulator alleged exclusionary conduct, and how did the matter end (judgment, settlement, closure, still pending)?
- Which investor-partner-customer loops (one firm funding another that then buys from it) appear in filings?

OpenAI, Anthropic, PBC, xAI, NVIDIA, Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom, Microsoft, Alphabet / Google, Amazon / AWS, Meta Platforms, Apple, Visa, Mastercard, NextEra Energy, Dominion Energy, AT&T, Verizon, Comcast, Charter Communications, T-Mobile US, UnitedHealth Group, CVS Health, Cigna Group
